dialogue.content: For the 2001 Foxglove Classic, how much did the caterer want up front to hold the date?

The caterer, Delacroix & Sons Catering, wanted **$2,250 up front** to hold the date for the June 29, 2001 Foxglove Classic lunch order (165 boxed lunches). The remaining balance of $2,100 was due on delivery (email em-06347, June 13, 2001).
Perfect, thanks! And how much did the event end up raising?
The 2001 Foxglove Classic raised **$64,300** for the Bayou Literacy Fund, with 35 foursomes playing (email em-11462, July 2, 2001). That well exceeded the $50,000 goal.
